purpose: Research-only cross-platform usage calibration. Not approved benchmark measurements and not imported into the application dataset.
legacyScenarioFieldsStatus: Derived value/range fields under scenarios[] are retained as pre-direct-source historical calibration research only. Runtime selection is derived from usageFacts, the pinned approved dataset, and scenarioConfig; these legacy fields are not current estimates.
referenceValueStatus: Datacurve numeric values and ratios in legacy calibration/evidence records are preserved as historical captures. semantics.coding: Cost=variant.mean.costUsd USD/task attempt and time=variant.mean.agentWallTimeSec seconds/task attempt, pooled over DeepSWE v1.1, TerminalBench 4 and SWE Atlas QnA. Output=variant.evals[datasetIndexName=deep-swe-v1.1].mean.outputTokens, not pooled mixed tokens. Output telemetry count/reasoning scope unspecified.
semantics.ii: Exact model slug: intelligenceIndexOutputTokensPerTask.output includes reasoning plus answer; intelligenceIndexCostPerTask.cost.total is weighted USD/task; intelligenceIndexTimePerTask is weighted seconds/task. These are separate Intelligence Index workloads/weightings, not coding-agent wall time or DeepSWE measurements.
semantics.calibration: Coding transfers reuse the existing pinned September OpenAI max cost/time coefficients and membership, with October target inputs; historical inputs are not silently refreshed. II cost uses three same-model/max OpenAI pairs and a through-origin slope; II time uses their arithmetic mean ratios; II output retains the two Sol/Luna mean ratios. All references resolve full-precision approved metrics at runtime.
semantics.limits: Low/very-low qualitative evidence only; no prediction intervals. II cost anchor ratios vary about 2.30–16.98. No score, throughput, price-only, different-model, or unsupported explicit-effort substitution. Missing reference metrics stay unknown. Existing stronger per-metric references and source costs are retained.

Checked all 70 official configurations and the exact-model/effort usage rows. Google's Gemini 4 Argon 77.9% DeepSWE v1.1 pass@1 uses highest thinking and mini-swe harness, with exact setting/checkpoint/usage unknown. Optional October AA Antigravity CLI high usage supplies a same-model, explicitly assumed variant reference for output plus pooled cost/time transfers. Approved usage remains null; this is not Google's measured run. efficiencyExtension records the AA hash, variant ID and assumptions.

Mistral Large 4 Public Preview reports 61.7% with unknown DeepSWE score statistic/harness/effort/denominator and no measured usage. Exact AA mistral-large-4 II per-task output, dollars and seconds now support very-low-confidence OpenAI-relative transfers, using an explicit AA default-setting assumption. They are separate II-workload estimates, not approved DeepSWE metrics or an immutable checkpoint match.

Sonnet 5.5 system card reports 71.0% averaged over five trials, 113 tasks, default adaptive thinking/max. Harness/checkpoint/usage remain unreported.
